name: accessibility-audit
description: Use this skill when conducting an accessibility audit of a page, component, or PR — distinct from building accessibly (use the accessibility skill for that). Two modes: quick PR triage or full client audit. Triggers: "audit for accessibility", "a11y check", "WCAG compliance", "is this accessible?", preparing a client accessibility report.
do-not-use-when: Building or fixing a component (use the accessibility skill for guidance)
A general UI design review with no accessibility scope
No UI, design artefacts, or code to review
